summary:
**EarthTrend AI – Detecting Change, Understanding Our Planet**

Our Earth is constantly changing, but understanding these changes through large amounts of environmental data isn't always easy. That's where EarthTrend AI comes in.

We developed EarthTrend AI, an interactive web platform that uses NASA POWER data to help people explore and understand how environmental conditions change over time.

Our platform allows users to study temperature, rainfall, humidity, wind speed, and solar radiation across different locations. It uses interactive graphs, maps, and statistical analysis to identify trends, measure how much things are changing, and check whether those changes are statistically significant.

One of the key features is the ability to compare different regions and see how the same environmental factor can behave differently from one place to another.

Through EarthTrend AI, we aim to make complex Earth science data easier to explore and understand, even for people without a scientific background. We believe that making environmental information more accessible is an important step toward better awareness, research, and informed decisions about our planet.
details:
EarthTrend AI – Understanding Our Changing Planet

About Our Project

Our Earth is constantly changing. Some places are getting warmer, rainfall patterns are shifting, and environmental conditions are changing in different ways across the world. But understanding these changes isn't always easy, especially when the information is spread across large amounts of scientific data.

This made us think: What if anyone could explore these changes and understand what is happening to our planet without needing advanced scientific knowledge?

That's how we came up with EarthTrend AI.

We developed an interactive web platform that uses NASA Earth science data to help people explore environmental changes, identify trends, and understand what those changes might mean.

How Does It Work?

EarthTrend AI connects to NASA POWER to collect historical environmental data.

Users can select a location, choose an environmental factor such as temperature, rainfall, humidity, wind speed, or solar radiation, and select the years they want to study.

Our platform then analyzes the data and displays easy-to-understand graphs showing how environmental conditions have changed over time.

We use the Mann–Kendall test to check whether a trend is statistically significant and Sen's slope to estimate how quickly a variable is increasing or decreasing.

One feature we're particularly excited about is regional comparison. A variable might increase in one place while decreasing in another. EarthTrend AI lets users compare these differences and explore results from multiple locations on a world map.

We have also included simple, automatically generated explanations to help users understand their results without getting confused by technical terms.

What Makes Our Project Special?

We didn't want to build just another website that displays graphs. We wanted to create something that helps people discover patterns and ask meaningful questions about our environment.

Our project focuses on answering four simple questions:

  • What is changing?
  • Where is it changing?
  • How much is it changing?
  • Is the change statistically significant?

By bringing all these answers together, EarthTrend AI makes environmental data easier to explore and understand.

Technologies We Used

We developed the project using Python and Streamlit, with NASA POWER as our environmental data source.

We used Pandas and NumPy to process the data, Plotly to create interactive graphs and maps, and PyMannKendall for statistical analysis.

We built and tested the application using Visual Studio Code, managed the project through GitHub, and deployed it using Streamlit Community Cloud.

Our project is entirely software-based, so users don't need any special hardware to access it.

Why Is This Project Important?

We believe understanding environmental changes shouldn't be limited to scientists and researchers.

Students can use EarthTrend AI to learn about Earth's changing environment. Researchers can use it to explore historical patterns, while people interested in agriculture, water resources, or climate can investigate environmental trends in different places.

Our current version focuses on selected locations rather than analyzing every part of the planet. We also understand that detecting a statistical trend doesn't automatically explain why that change happened. That's why we present our findings as evidence for further investigation rather than definite conclusions.

Our Future Vision

EarthTrend AI is our first step toward making Earth science data more accessible.

In the future, we hope to include more NASA Earth observation datasets, detailed global environmental maps, and advanced analysis features that can help users discover connections between different environmental changes.

Through this project, we want to encourage more people to become curious about our planet and understand the changes happening around them.

For us, EarthTrend AI is not just about analyzing data. It's about helping people see, explore, and better understand our changing Earth.
